Name: Busty Zuzu City Girl (Shiko)
Author: wetfart
Description:
Use with the excellent [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3732]Shiko mod[/url] to reskin her as a thiccer model via Content Patcher.
Or reskin any character of your choice with a few changes to the JSON files - PM me if you need help!

[b]NOTE: [/b]I did not modify, redistribute, or reuse any assets from the Shiko mod.
This mod will not do anything unless you either download and install the Shiko mod, or modify the JSON to reskin a character of your choosing.

[i]This mod dynamically loads several different portraits and sprites:[/i]
[list=1]
[*][b]Default[/b] - wears plain black clothes with low-cut top
[*][b]Sunny [/b]day, while[b] Outdoors [/b]- wears sunglasses with default outfit
[*][b]Sunny [/b]day, in [b]Summer [/b]or [b]Spring[/b], while at the [b]Beach [/b]- wears bikini and sunglasses
[*]Inside the [b]FarmHouse[/b] - wears a semi-transparent slip
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
For all the nipple haters out there.
Install the main file first, then extract this to overwrite the images.

Content Pack containing new portraits and sprites.

Use with the default content.json to reskin Shiko (if installed),
or modify the json to reskin a target character of your choice.
